configJson.title: SubSell settings as a JSON string
configJson.description: Paste the contents of an exported subsell-config.json here (API key + business settings). Pushed to this machine by enterprise policy; highest priority. This is how the whole fleet gets the key with nothing typed per machine.

configUrl.title: URL to fetch the settings JSON from
configUrl.description: Alternative to configJson: a URL the extension fetches the settings from (e.g. a secret gist raw link).
